entries.german: König Ruprecht gestattet den Brüdern Arnold und Eberhard von Rosenberg in ihrem Dorf Schweigern ein Halsgericht, Stock und Galgen zu haben.
entries.english: King Ruprecht allows the brothers Arnold and Eberhard von Rosenberg to have a neck court, stocks and gallows in their village of Schweigern.

facts.content: received King Ruprecht’s permission jointly with his brother [eberhard_jagstberg] to have a high court, stocks, and gallows in Schweigern.
received King Ruprecht’s permission jointly with his brother [arnold_boxberg] to have a high court, stocks, and gallows in Schweigern.

entries.german: König Ruprecht erlaubt den Gebrüdern Arnolt und Eberhard von Rosenberg, in ihrem Dorfe „Sweyern vnd in sinem begriffe“ Schultheiss und Schöffen, ein Halsgericht, Stock und Galgen künftig daselbst zu haben, C.
entries.english: King Ruprecht permits the brothers Arnold and Eberhard von Rosenberg to henceforth have a reeve and aldermen, a high court of justice, stocks, and gallows in their village "Schweigern and in its jurisdiction," C.

facts.content: received King Ruprecht’s permission jointly with his brother [eberhard_jagstberg] to appoint a reeve and aldermen and to have a high court, stocks, and gallows in Schweigern and its jurisdiction.
received King Ruprecht’s permission jointly with his brother [arnold_boxberg] to appoint a reeve and aldermen and to have a high court, stocks, and gallows in Schweigern and its jurisdiction.
